scope: Documented capability families and proposed runtime-independent counterparts; not a live parity claim

capabilities.name: Autonomous task execution
capabilities.manus_usage: Describe the outcome and provide inputs.
capabilities.workspace_route: Plan, execute tools, inspect, recover, and deliver through durable runs.
capabilities.acceptance: Result and tool receipts survive restart.

capabilities.name: Plan mode
capabilities.manus_usage: Use / → Plan; review/edit before Confirm.
capabilities.workspace_route: Offer explicit plan-only mode with editable goals and gates.
capabilities.acceptance: No task side effects before requested plan approval.

capabilities.name: Projects and knowledge
capabilities.manus_usage: Create a project with instructions and knowledge files.
capabilities.workspace_route: Version Space instructions and files; scope every task.
capabilities.acceptance: New tasks use the recorded configuration without cross-Space leakage.

capabilities.name: Reusable skills
capabilities.manus_usage: Add/build/import a skill; invoke from the skill menu.
capabilities.workspace_route: Progressive local or learned-skill delivery with scoped reference reads.
capabilities.acceptance: Relevant skill loads; traversal and unrelated script execution fail.

capabilities.name: Project learning
capabilities.manus_usage: Review project updates learned from completed work.
capabilities.workspace_route: Store attributed, reviewable memory candidates with versions and rollback.
capabilities.acceptance: A correction affects the intended future tasks only.

capabilities.name: Conversation branching
capabilities.manus_usage: Branch at a message to explore another direction.
capabilities.workspace_route: Snapshot context and artifacts; run an isolated child task.
capabilities.acceptance: Original stays intact; parent/revision lineage remains visible.

capabilities.name: Wide research
capabilities.manus_usage: Ask for many entities with a consistent output schema.
capabilities.workspace_route: Fan out bounded item tasks, validate rows, synthesize with sources.
capabilities.acceptance: Every requested entity has evidence or a visible failure/unknown.

capabilities.name: Search and source reading
capabilities.manus_usage: Ask for source-backed web investigation.
capabilities.workspace_route: Search, fetch, quote sparingly, compare primary evidence, preserve claims.
capabilities.acceptance: Citations resolve and support the attached claims.

capabilities.name: Cloud browser
capabilities.manus_usage: Open sites using the cloud browser; take over when needed.
capabilities.workspace_route: Use an available isolated browser with fresh-state inspection.
capabilities.acceptance: Navigation and authorized action have observed receipts.

capabilities.name: Authenticated local browser
capabilities.manus_usage: Connect Browser Operator to the authorized browser.
capabilities.workspace_route: Add a supported local-browser bridge with per-session authorization.
capabilities.acceptance: Uses the selected account; takeover/revocation works.

capabilities.name: Local files and applications
capabilities.manus_usage: Authorize folders in My Computer and use its command controls.
capabilities.workspace_route: Implement a scoped local executor separately from cloud containers.
capabilities.acceptance: Only permitted roots/apps are accessible; cancel works.

capabilities.name: Persistent cloud computer
capabilities.manus_usage: Assign a dedicated Cloud Computer when the project needs one.
capabilities.workspace_route: Provision isolated persistent storage/compute with actual hosting tooling.
capabilities.acceptance: Files and background services survive client disconnect/restart.

capabilities.name: Remote computer control
capabilities.manus_usage: Use a connected authorized computer session from another device.
capabilities.workspace_route: Implement authenticated remote viewing, commands, takeover, and revocation.
capabilities.acceptance: Live state and scoped control work across devices.

capabilities.name: Structured data extraction
capabilities.manus_usage: Upload files and specify fields/analysis.
capabilities.workspace_route: Parse/OCR with typed schemas, raw input preservation, and provenance.
capabilities.acceptance: Counts, required fields, uncertainty, and totals reconcile.

capabilities.name: Spreadsheets
capabilities.manus_usage: Request analysis and a spreadsheet output.
capabilities.workspace_route: Create formulas, tables, formatting, charts, and recalculate.
capabilities.acceptance: Workbook opens; formulas, totals, and edit round trip pass.

capabilities.name: Charts and dashboards
capabilities.manus_usage: Select desired visualizations and delivery format.
capabilities.workspace_route: Compute data before rendering accessible static/interactive views.
capabilities.acceptance: Plotted values and filter behavior match underlying data.

capabilities.name: Documents and reports
capabilities.manus_usage: Request an editable document from the project context.
capabilities.workspace_route: Author native/local document with sources, sections, tables, and links.
capabilities.acceptance: Rendered pages and editable source match requirements.

capabilities.name: PDF workflows
capabilities.manus_usage: Provide or request a PDF in the workspace.
capabilities.workspace_route: Extract/OCR, fill or annotate as needed, render, preserve source.
capabilities.acceptance: Page content/forms and layout inspected; output decodes.

capabilities.name: Slides and templates
capabilities.manus_usage: Import a PPTX template or describe a deck and audience.
capabilities.workspace_route: Build editable slides, data charts, generated visuals, notes, exports.
capabilities.acceptance: Every slide renders cleanly and remains editable.

capabilities.name: Image generation
capabilities.manus_usage: Describe the image and intended format.
capabilities.workspace_route: Route native Codex image tool or configured image API; inspect output.
capabilities.acceptance: Actual asset, dimensions, content, provenance, and cost receipt.

capabilities.name: Image understanding and OCR
capabilities.manus_usage: Upload images and ask for text or visual analysis.
capabilities.workspace_route: Combine vision/OCR with uncertainty and source regions.
capabilities.acceptance: Key extracted fields checked against original pixels.

capabilities.name: Design view and local edits
capabilities.manus_usage: Mark a region or add a reference; edit text/elements.
capabilities.workspace_route: Build mask/reference controls, versioned edits, text layers, undo.
capabilities.acceptance: Requested region changes while invariants are inspected.

capabilities.name: Video generation
capabilities.manus_usage: Choose video and describe the requested clip.
capabilities.workspace_route: Discover model controls, generate shots asynchronously, save outputs.
capabilities.acceptance: Playable clip satisfies duration/aspect/content checks.

capabilities.name: Video understanding
capabilities.manus_usage: Provide recording/link and request analysis.
capabilities.workspace_route: Probe, transcribe, sample frames, index timestamps and limits.
capabilities.acceptance: Claims link to inspected audio/frames with sampling disclosed.

capabilities.name: Editable video studio
capabilities.manus_usage: Generate a video, then edit its tracks in Studio.
capabilities.workspace_route: Persist separate tracks and implement timeline UI, autosave, undo, render.
capabilities.acceptance: Manual edit survives agent revision and changes the final export.

capabilities.name: Creative-direction video
capabilities.manus_usage: Use the advanced creative workflow for a full film.
capabilities.workspace_route: Research, script, storyboard, references, shots, code motion, sound, QA.
capabilities.acceptance: Complete film plus editable project and sources, not isolated clips.

capabilities.name: UGC and social variants
capabilities.manus_usage: Request a creator-style product video or short-form cut.
capabilities.workspace_route: Use truthful scripts, consented assets, captions, intentional reframing.
capabilities.acceptance: No invented testimonial; requested platform variants play correctly.

capabilities.name: Voiceover and speech
capabilities.manus_usage: Request narration in the desired tone/language.
capabilities.workspace_route: Generate speech through a configured provider with pronunciation checks.
capabilities.acceptance: Audio intelligibility, script coverage, rights, and sync checked.

capabilities.name: Music and sound effects
capabilities.manus_usage: Connect audio tools and describe soundtrack/effects.
capabilities.workspace_route: Generate or license stems; mix, duck, align, and preserve tracks.
capabilities.acceptance: No clipping; speech audible; rights and editable stems retained.

capabilities.name: Speech transcription
capabilities.manus_usage: Upload audio and request timestamped speaker-labeled text.
capabilities.workspace_route: Chunk with overlap; reconcile timestamps, names, and uncertainty.
capabilities.acceptance: Transcript evidence and uncertain segments retained.

capabilities.name: Meeting minutes to actions
capabilities.manus_usage: Record a discussion, finish, and use notes as task context.
capabilities.workspace_route: Capture with visible consent, transcribe, extract attributed decisions/actions.
capabilities.acceptance: Notes match evidence; external actions follow actual authorization.

capabilities.name: Website and full-stack builder
capabilities.manus_usage: Describe an app; refine the plan and preview.
capabilities.workspace_route: Build real UI, backend, persistence, auth, tests, and preview.
capabilities.acceptance: Primary journey passes with real data and errors handled.

capabilities.name: Visual web editing
capabilities.manus_usage: Select an element or describe scoped visual edits.
capabilities.workspace_route: Map selection to source, patch narrowly, live preview, undo.
capabilities.acceptance: Target changes without unrelated regressions.

capabilities.name: Backend, database, storage
capabilities.manus_usage: Request persistent app behavior and file uploads.
capabilities.workspace_route: Provision actual services, migrations, storage, backups, observability.
capabilities.acceptance: Data/file round trip and restore work.

capabilities.name: Access control
capabilities.manus_usage: Request login and role-specific areas.
capabilities.workspace_route: Enforce server identity/resource authorization; expose user controls.
capabilities.acceptance: Denied users cannot read/write protected data.

capabilities.name: Payments
capabilities.manus_usage: Add payments, test sandbox, then separately activate live service.
capabilities.workspace_route: Use configured test provider; validate signed events and fulfillment.
capabilities.acceptance: Checkout success/failure and duplicate webhook tests pass.

capabilities.name: Deployment and hosting modes
capabilities.manus_usage: Publish; choose hosting suitable for the workload.
capabilities.workspace_route: Use authorized hosting API/CLI with preview, health check, rollback.
capabilities.acceptance: Live URL responds; persistence/workers match chosen hosting.

capabilities.name: Custom domains and TLS
capabilities.manus_usage: Connect a domain in publishing settings.
capabilities.workspace_route: Verify ownership/DNS/TLS with actual provider tools.
capabilities.acceptance: Domain serves intended version through valid HTTPS.

capabilities.name: Analytics and data browser
capabilities.manus_usage: Inspect app metrics and database records.
capabilities.workspace_route: Add measured events, dashboard, authorized record/schema management.
capabilities.acceptance: Real events appear and unauthorized edits fail.

capabilities.name: SEO
capabilities.manus_usage: Inspect page SEO and apply selected improvements.
capabilities.workspace_route: Implement crawlable pages, metadata, canonicals, sitemap, robots.
capabilities.acceptance: Fetch/render confirms signals; private content stays protected.

capabilities.name: Notifications
capabilities.manus_usage: Describe which app events should notify whom.
capabilities.workspace_route: Add authorized in-app/email delivery with outbox/deduplication.
capabilities.acceptance: One event produces one intended notification.

capabilities.name: Code export and GitHub
capabilities.manus_usage: Connect/export code and inspect sync state.
capabilities.workspace_route: Preserve source ownership, branches, review workflow, and conflict handling.
capabilities.acceptance: Export builds; manual changes survive synchronization.

capabilities.name: Project copying
capabilities.manus_usage: Make a copy for an independent experiment.
capabilities.workspace_route: Copy code/schema with explicit artifact policy and unbound secret references.
capabilities.acceptance: Copy is independent and unpublished; credentials do not leak.

capabilities.name: Figma to application
capabilities.manus_usage: Supply authorized frame links and describe behavior.
capabilities.workspace_route: Read design assets/tokens, implement, compare screenshots and interactions.
capabilities.acceptance: Frame fidelity and real application behavior verified.

capabilities.name: Mobile builds and test distribution
capabilities.manus_usage: Prepare Android AAB or iOS TestFlight build.
capabilities.workspace_route: Build/sign using configured accounts; distinguish testing and store release.
capabilities.acceptance: Installable tested package; distribution receipts if authorized.

capabilities.name: Game creation and tuning
capabilities.manus_usage: Create a game; adjust the game-specific tweak panel.
capabilities.workspace_route: Build loop, live parameters, asset management, art/audio, playtests.
capabilities.acceptance: Playable controls, win/loss/restart and persisted tuning.

capabilities.name: Multiplayer game hosting
capabilities.manus_usage: Configure multiplayer with persistent compute.
capabilities.workspace_route: Implement shared authoritative state, rooms, reconnect, and hosting.
capabilities.acceptance: Two-client play and reconnect verified on deployed service.

capabilities.name: Time-based automations
capabilities.manus_usage: Automations → Create → Schedule.
capabilities.workspace_route: Register durable IANA-timezone jobs with next-run/history and misfire rules.
capabilities.acceptance: Matching time, restart, DST, overlap, pause tested.

capabilities.name: Event-triggered workflows
capabilities.manus_usage: Choose Trigger or Advanced automation and source-specific conditions.
capabilities.workspace_route: Authenticated ingress/polling, condition validation, dedupe, scoped execution.
capabilities.acceptance: Match/nonmatch/duplicate/revocation cases behave correctly.

capabilities.name: App-owned and user-owned schedules
capabilities.manus_usage: Request recurring app jobs or end-user schedule controls.
capabilities.workspace_route: Bind every schedule to owner, app, budgets, timezone, and workflow.
capabilities.acceptance: Users cannot change each other's schedules; executions are traceable.

capabilities.name: Connectors and custom MCP
capabilities.manus_usage: Connect supported apps or an authorized custom MCP server.
capabilities.workspace_route: Discover schemas, bind accounts, validate tool results, enforce scopes.
capabilities.acceptance: A real scoped read/write passes; unavailable tools remain blocked.

capabilities.name: Premium data sources
capabilities.manus_usage: Ask for supported external data in the task.
capabilities.workspace_route: Use licensed provider APIs with date, definitions, quota, and provenance.
capabilities.acceptance: Account access and returned data verified; no fabricated premium data.

capabilities.name: Slack collaboration
capabilities.manus_usage: Mention Manus in an authorized thread.
capabilities.workspace_route: Use Channels with actor mapping and thread/run identity.
capabilities.acceptance: Right thread receives authorized result once.

capabilities.name: Email task interface
capabilities.manus_usage: Configure approved senders and forward to task/workflow address.
capabilities.workspace_route: Add authenticated inbound mail, attachment handling, thread mapping, outbox.
capabilities.acceptance: Unapproved sender/loop blocked; authorized task/result traceable.

capabilities.name: Human collaboration
capabilities.manus_usage: Share task for collaboration with selected people.
capabilities.workspace_route: Implement invitations, roles, attributable edits, and conflicts.
capabilities.acceptance: Concurrent edits preserve revisions; access revocation works.

capabilities.name: External API and Zapier
capabilities.manus_usage: Use current API or workflow connector to create/manage tasks.
capabilities.workspace_route: Expose authenticated task/file API, webhook events, idempotency, rate limits.
capabilities.acceptance: Client can create, observe, cancel, and retrieve real outputs.

capabilities.name: Bring-your-own-model
capabilities.manus_usage: Configure supported provider key, model, and effort.
capabilities.workspace_route: Capability-check model adapter and structured/tool/vision behavior.
capabilities.acceptance: Real tool round trip works; costs are separately accounted.

capabilities.name: Agent teams and personal agents
capabilities.manus_usage: Cue supports agent groups; keep its separate-product boundary explicit.
capabilities.workspace_route: Implement real coordinator/workers, handoffs, persistent context, resource caps.
capabilities.acceptance: Independent tasks integrate; no fabricated workers or shared-secret leakage.

capabilities.name: Agent identities, phone, wallet
capabilities.manus_usage: Cue describes separate agent identities and service access.
capabilities.workspace_route: Add separately configured messaging/telephony/budgeted-payment services only when requested.
capabilities.acceptance: Account control, spend caps, human authority, and delivery tested.

capabilities.name: Continuous publishing
capabilities.manus_usage: Configure Auto-Publish for repeated authorized releases.
capabilities.workspace_route: Versioned build/test/deploy workflow with bounded authorization and rollback.
capabilities.acceptance: Failed build stays unpublished; successful authorized release is traceable.
